steps.text: Run holo service:up / curl /health — 200 with DB/fleet/queue readiness
steps.literal_cmd: code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/g5-s1.json -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:4111/health); echo body=$(cat /tmp/g5-s1.json); echo HTTP_$code; test "$code" = "200" && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/g5-s1.json')); assert d['status']=='ok' and d['db']['ready'] and d['fleet']['ready'] and d['queue']['ready']; print('HEALTH_OK')"
code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/g5-s2.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions/x/steer); echo body=$(cat /tmp/g5-s2.json); echo HTTP_$code; test "$code" = "401"

code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/g5-s3.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer rn-test" http://127.0.0.1:4111/api/missions/x/steer); echo body=$(cat /tmp/g5-s3.json); echo HTTP_$code; test "$code" = "200"

steps.text: curl MCP mutation with RN key (wrong scope) — 403
steps.literal_cmd: code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/g5-s4.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer rn-test" http://127.0.0.1:4111/mcp); echo body=$(cat /tmp/g5-s4.json); echo HTTP_$code; test "$code" = "403"

steps.text: holo registry:probe searchTool — same Zod schema for agent/workflow/MCP
steps.literal_cmd: out=$(bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts registry:probe searchTool 2>&1); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q "resolvedId: search_tools" && echo "$out" | grep -q "consumer.agent: inputSame=true" && echo "$out" | grep -q "consumer.workflow: inputSame=true" && echo "$out" | grep -q "consumer.mcp: inputSame=true" && echo PROBE_OK

bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts verify:no-dup-validation > /tmp/g5-s6.json 2>/tmp/g5-s6.err; cat /tmp/g5-s6.json; cat /tmp/g5-s6.err >&2 || true; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/g5-s6.json')); assert d.get('duplicates')==0; print('NO_DUP_OK')"

steps.text: holo manifest:resolve divergent — live fleet endpoint
steps.literal_cmd: bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts manifest:resolve divergent > /tmp/g5-s7.json 2>/tmp/g5-s7.err; cat /tmp/g5-s7.json; cat /tmp/g5-s7.err >&2 || true; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/g5-s7.json')); assert ':4545' in str(d.get('endpoint','')); print('RESOLVE_OK', d['endpoint'])"
